proof_body:
by
  intro a b hb hba
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := le_trans hb hba
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt ha
  have ht := Real.sq_sqrt hb
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul ha]
  have h : a + b - 2 * (Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt b) = (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b) ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination -hs - ht
  rw [h]
  exact Real.sqrt_sq (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hba))
target_source: ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ b → b ≤ a → Real.sqrt (a + b - 2 * Real.sqrt (a * b)) = Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b
